text:
sanjay: Heads-up — big enterprise onramp request landed from AcmeCorp. They want a temporary softcap + surge credits for first 90 days. Need quick alignment for Q2 sprint planning.
kelly: Can you paste the ask? numbers?
sanjay: Quote: 'Allow short-term 2x burst above committed slab, plus a 30k free-credit bucket for onboarding, with a softcap that alerts but doesn't block.' They want contract language for 90d pilot.
mike: On the surface seems doable but impacts capacity planning. Is this gated behind reserved capacity or hosted API usage?
sanjay: Hosted API. They expect predictable latency, may request SLAs if we enable burst.
anne: Launch criteria proposal: 1) Define softcap alerting + UX in console, 2) Limit burst to 2x for 90d, 3) Cost protection guardrails (auto-fallback to degraded model if sustained beyond burst), 4) Legal sign-off on pilot clause.
legal-bot: FYI suggested clause: "Pilot burst credits are time-limited, non-transferable, revocable at Redwood's discretion; sustained overage subject to billed usage or auto-fallback." Need POI on dataplane isolation?
finance-sara: Need revenue-impact calc. Quick sanity: if 2x burst triggers 20% of time, projected variable cost to us ~ $12k/mo for this account; onboarding credits reduce first-month revenue. Will need to surface to sales comp.
eng-max: Implementation notes: console flags + meter changes should be ~2 sprint-days. Auto-fallback (model downgrade) is harder — needs routing policy + compatibility checks across model variants, estimate 3-4 sprint-days plus QA.
kelly: Are we comfortable shipping UX without auto-fallback initially? Could we ship alert + manual ops-runbook first to unblock sales?
mike: Risk: if burst spikes and ops isn't ready we'll see latency/regression alerts. Ops-runbook ok for pilot if sales accepts higher risk.
anne: Proposed trade: MVP = alerting + credits + contract pilot clause. Stretch = auto-fallback and SLA add-on. Gate to GA: no incidents from pilot + clear unit-cost < X.
legal-bot: Also add customer obligations: rate-limits, burst pattern reporting. Helps dispute resolution.
finance-sara: If MVP agreed, run a 90d P&L stub and include a clause that credits expire at 90d. We can also cap total free-credit IO to $30k.
sanjay: Sounds like consensus. Action items: Anne to own spec (MVP vs stretch), Eng-Max to spike implementation estimate for fallback, Legal to draft pilot clause, Finance to run P&L stub, Sales to confirm AcmeCorp accepts pilot risk.
anne: I'll draft spec by EOD tomorrow and post here. If anyone has specific constraints (latency floor, regional requirements), drop them here. :thumbsup:
mike: FYI I'll flag capacity team and ask for warm standby.
eng-max: Quick note — model downgrade requires model-compatibility matrix; I'll include that in the estimate.
kelly: Thanks — this is a helpful framing.
sanjay: Great, thanks everyone. I'll loop in sales ops and customer success now. :rocket:
